roles.criterion: what a perfect question or lesson has
roles.method: how to make or check one
roles.context: what bounds the others: limits, measures, research

facets.key: the right answer and its marking
facets.stimulus: the text, document or source a question rests on
facets.scoring-guide: the rubric or marking guide for written answers
facets.feedback: what a student is told after answering
facets.hints: help before the answer is given
facets.alignment: fit to the objective, unit and what was taught
facets.sequence: order and spacing across a lesson or course
facets.evaluation: judging content with a model or code
facets.measurement: how quality and learning are measured

stages.ground: fix the objective, the scope and the facts before writing
stages.write: draft the stimulus, question, options, guide and feedback
stages.settle: check in code everything code can decide
stages.judge: ask bounded questions of an independent judge
stages.review: people and scripted readers check what the judge can't
stages.measure: measure quality and learning the same way each time
stages.improve: fix causes, one change at a time
